verdict.rationale: Trilegal's own IP page says it represents clients in high-stakes litigation involving patents, trademarks, copyrights, design rights and trade secrets, so it clearly claims an IP litigation practice. But the evidence names no courts, venues, case outcomes or specific matters; the only concrete IP engagement cited is advisory diligence work. Missing for 10: named courts or venues (e.g. Delhi High Court), described case outcomes or reported matters, and independent corroboration of IP litigation results.
